2608.13076.title: SPADE: Speculative Decoding for Precise and Low Cost Distributed Edge Cloud Inference
2608.13076.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in natural language understanding and generation, but their deployment is constrained by high computational demands. Deploying smaller LLMs directly on the edge can circumvent this, but with degraded accuracy. Deploying smaller cloud-based big LLMs preserves performance, but at the cost of expensive per-token computation. We present a distributed inference framework, \our{}, that integrates speculative decoding (SD) across edge and cloud. A compact draft model deployed on the edge generates candidate tokens rapidly, and a large verifier model on the cloud validates these tokens in parallel. Accepted tokens are retained, while only rejections trigger verifier correction, substantially reducing the number of cloud queries. Our plug-and-play design shifts the bulk of computation to the edge, significantly lowers inference time and cloud cost, and preserves the accuracy of the big model without any retraining requirement. Our approach demonstrates a practical path toward scalable, cost-efficient, and accurate deployment of LLMs in real-world environments. Experimental results across multiple Natural Language Processing tasks using SpecBench and CNN/Dailymail datasets demonstrate that \our{} reduces the cloud model calls by $76\%$ with zero loss in accuracy as compared to the full model.
2608.13076.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在自然語言理解和生成方面取得了顯著的成功，但其部署受到高計算需求的限制。直接在邊緣部署較小的LLMs可以繞過這一點，但準確性會下降。部署較小的基於雲的大型LLMs則能保持性能，但代價是昂貴的每個標記計算。我們提出了一個分佈式推理框架，\our{}，它在邊緣和雲之間整合了推測解碼（SD）。在邊緣部署的緊湊草稿模型快速生成候選標記，而雲端的大型驗證模型則並行驗證這些標記。接受的標記被保留，而只有拒絕的情況會觸發驗證者的修正，從而大幅減少雲查詢的次數。我們的即插即用設計將大部分計算轉移到邊緣，顯著降低推理時間和雲成本，並在不需要任何再訓練的情況下保持大型模型的準確性。我們的方法展示了一條實用的路徑，朝向可擴展、成本效益高且準確的LLMs在現實環境中的部署。使用SpecBench和CNN/Dailymail數據集進行的多個自然語言處理任務的實驗結果顯示，與完整模型相比，\our{}將雲模型調用減少了$76\%$，而準確性沒有損失。
